x-openregister._seedDataNote: Seed objects MOVED to lib/Settings/profiles/*.json (OpenSpec change seed-profiles). A register.d fragment declares SCHEMAS ONLY, so installing this app plants zero objects. The examples that used to live here are now part of an example set an operator picks in the first-time setup wizard, which is the only thing that imports them.

Toezegging.title: Toezegging
Toezegging.description: A political commitment (toezegging) made by a portefeuillehouder or college member to a council or committee, tracked from the moment it is made in a meeting through afdoening, with a deadline, declarative rappels (ADR-031), and a live public toezeggingenlijst via the OpenRegister published-predicate. A toezegging is a public-accountability instrument: it is NOT an ActionItem (CalDAV VTODO) and NOT motion-execution tracking (UitvoeringsUpdate), it only cross-references both. CONSTRAINT (design D4): this schema contains ONLY publishable fields by construction (no internal-only property). Adding ANY non-public property requires revisiting the public-predicate design in D4, because the whole live object is exposed through the public-group authorization.read rule when publicationDate <= $now.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-002). Canonical dialect verbatim from the Decision schema (keyword 'initial', never 'initialState'/'default'). open → in-uitvoering → afgedaan | vervallen; afgedaan and vervallen terminal. Afdoening (afgedaan) always passes through in-uitvoering; a not-yet-started commitment may lapse directly (open → vervallen). No app-side state machine.

toezeggingRappelBeforeDeadline._note: Pre-deadline rappel (REQ-004). intervalSec 1209600 (~14 days) is PROVISIONAL (design open question — griffie-configurable tuning deferred). Filter targets non-terminal lifecycle only; the 'deadline within window' vs 'deadline past' distinction is carried by the scheduled engine's window semantics, which the simple filter shape shown for Meeting cannot express as a deadline comparison — verify OR's scheduled-notification engine interprets these two triggers as before/after-deadline rappels during live import.

toezeggingRappelOverdue._note: Overdue rappel (REQ-004). intervalSec 604800 (weekly) is PROVISIONAL. Filters non-terminal lifecycle so no notification fires for afgedaan/vervallen. Same window-semantics caveat as toezeggingRappelBeforeDeadline. Recipients approximate 'madeBy + griffie' via object-acl (read) + decidesk-members group, because no recipient kind targets the madeBy Person reference directly.

text.title: Commitment
text.description: The commitment itself (what was promised, by whom, on what).
text.example: Wethouder Van Dijk zegt toe de raad vóór 1 maart per raadsbrief te informeren over de wachtlijsten jeugdzorg.

madeBy.title: Made by
madeBy.description: Reference to the portefeuillehouder / college member who made the commitment (schema:Action agent). Required.

meeting.title: Meeting
meeting.description: Reference to the Meeting in which the commitment was made. Required.

agendaItem.title: Agenda item
agendaItem.description: Reference to the AgendaItem the commitment relates to. Optional.

directedTo.title: Directed to
directedTo.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody the commitment is directed to (council/committee). Required.

deadline.title: Deadline
deadline.description: Date by which the commitment should be settled. Optional; drives the declarative rappels and the overdue dashboard KPI.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Commitment status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): open → in-uitvoering → afgedaan | vervallen. afgedaan and vervallen are terminal. Marking afgedaan SHOULD carry an afdoeningsToelichting.

settlementNotes.title: Afdoening note
settlementNotes.description: Note explaining how the commitment was settled (recorded when moving to afgedaan). Optional.

settlementEvidence.title: Afdoening evidence
settlementEvidence.description: Link or reference to evidence of afdoening (e.g. the raadsbrief). Optional. A plain URL/reference string: not a UID field, so the object stays fully publishable (design D4).

relatedMotion.title: Related motion
relatedMotion.description: Optional reference to a Decision of decisionType 'motion' this commitment stems from. When set, the execution narrative lives ONLY on that motion's UitvoeringsUpdate log (motie-amendement-administratie); this register creates no second execution-update log (REQ-003).

goal.title: Goal
goal.description: Optional reference to the organisation Goal (organisation-goals change) this commitment serves. When set, this commitment is counted in that Goal's declarative linkedCommitmentCount/settledCommitmentCount rollup (organisation-goals REQ-006). Nullable; existing toezeggingen created before this change remain valid with no goal set.

publicationDate.title: Publication date
publicationDate.description: Publication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set in the past, the live toezegging is anonymously readable through the OpenRegister published-predicate (public-group authorization.read rule publicationDate <= $now). Publish is an explicit staff action; because the predicate sits on the live object the public list reflects lifecycle changes without republication (REQ-005 / design D4).

depublicationDate.title: Depublication date
depublicationDate.description: Depublication date (WOO/DIWOO). When set and in the past, the toezegging is withdrawn from public access. Set by staff on withdraw.

IngekomenStuk.title: IngekomenStuk
IngekomenStuk.description: An incoming document registered by the council griffie (letter from a resident or organisation, college submission, petition, invitation): a griffie routing advice per document, placement on the 'Lijst ingekomen stukken' AgendaItem of the next council meeting, bulk council confirmation via the hamerstuk flow, follow-up status tracking, and WOO-aware public publication in which natural-person senders are anonymised. The LIVE object is never public (a sender may be a natural person, WOO/AVG); public exposure runs exclusively through the derived immutable PublicationPayload (design D4/D7). Files attach via the existing Files leaf.

x-openregister-lifecycle._note: Declarative guarded transition map (ADR-031, REQ-002). geregistreerd → geagendeerd → routering-vastgesteld → afgedaan, plus aangehouden reachable from geagendeerd and routering-vastgesteld and returning to geagendeerd for a later meeting. afgedaan terminal. No app-side state machine.

title.title: Title
title.description: Subject / title of the incoming document. Required.

sender.title: Sender
sender.description: Display name of the sender. Required. For senderType natuurlijk-persoon this is PII and is structurally anonymised to a neutral label ('Inwoner') in the public payload (REQ-005); never rendered as-is publicly.

senderType.title: Sender type
senderType.description: Nature of the sender: drives public anonymisation (natuurlijk-persoon is anonymised, organisatie/bestuursorgaan pass through). Required.

receivedAt.title: Received at
receivedAt.description: Date the document was received by the griffie. Required.

summary.title: Summary
summary.description: Optional short summary of the document's content.

routingAdvice.title: Routing advice
routingAdvice.description: Griffie routing advice for the document. Optional until advised. CONSTRAINT: when set to 'betrekken-bij-agendapunt', targetAgendaItem MUST be referenced, this conditional-required rule is NOT expressible in the OR schema 'required' array (no if/then dialect is used here to avoid inventing one); it is enforced at save time by IngekomenStukRoutingService (Tasks 5-8) and documented here per REQ-001.

targetAgendaItem.title: Target agenda item
targetAgendaItem.description: Reference to the AgendaItem the document should be handled under. REQUIRED when routingAdvice is 'betrekken-bij-agendapunt' (conditional-required, enforced at save time: see routingAdvice). Optional otherwise.

listAgendaItem.title: List agenda item
listAgendaItem.description: Reference to the 'Lijst ingekomen stukken' AgendaItem this document is placed on. Set by the placement action (which also moves lifecycle to geagendeerd). Optional until placed.

directedTo.title: Directed to
directedTo.description: Reference to the GovernanceBody (council) the document is directed to. Required.

lifecycle.title: Lifecycle
lifecycle.description: Follow-up status (declared in x-openregister-lifecycle, ADR-031): geregistreerd → geagendeerd → routering-vastgesteld → afgedaan, with an aangehouden loop. afgedaan is terminal.
